name: Mametsuhime Mikoto ~Jusei Hisshi no Ishu Kangoku~
original_name: 魔滅姫ミコト～受精必至の異種姦獄～
source:
In a world where humans and different magical races coexist, interactions between them bring both benefits and an increase in heinous crimes by the magical beings. To counter the rising darkness and ensure peace for innocent people and virtuous magical beings, a special intelligence agency called Kamizuchi is established to eliminate corrupt individuals from both groups. The story follows a feared operative known as the Demon Slayer Princess and her succubus partner, Elmia, as they team up to solve crimes, engaging in deadly battles to uphold law and order.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ309422.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在人类与不同魔法种族共存的世界里，他们之间的互动既带来了好处，也增加了魔法生物的滔天罪行。为了对抗不断上升的黑暗并确保无辜人民和善良魔法生物的和平，成立了一个名为“Kamizuchi”的特殊情报机构，以消除这两个群体中的腐败分子。故事讲述了一位令人畏惧的恶魔杀手公主和她的魅魔搭档艾尔米娅，他们联手破案，为维护法律和秩序而进行的殊死战斗。
